name: English Extended Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements for a Major

requirements.title: Students complete any two 100-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 111W, ENGL 112W, ENGL 113W, ENGL 114W, ENGL 115W, ENGL 199W

requirements.title: Students also complete any four 200-division English courses
requirements.note: Such courses may include: ENGL 202, ENGL 204, ENGL 209, ENGL 210, ENGL 211, ENGL 213, ENGL 214 and 3 more

sections.note: Students wishing to major in English are strongly advised to submit a formal declaration to this effect to the undergraduate advisor upon completing all lower division requirements.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements for a Minor

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete 16 units of upper division English courses, at least four of which must be at the 400 level (excluding any directed studies courses, i.e., ENGL 490 and 491).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must maintain at least a 2.00 grade point average in English courses.

sections.note: No courses from other departments may be substituted for this program's English courses.

grades.label: Upper Division Requirements for a Minor
grades.text: Students must maintain at least a 2.00 grade point average in English courses.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: For all bachelor of arts (BA) programs, students complete 120 units, which includes at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 45 upper division units, of which at least 30 upper division units must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 60 units (including 21 upper division units) in Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences courses satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division overall CGPA of at least 2.0, and program CGPA and upper division program CGPA of at least 2.0 on the course work used to satisfy the minimum program requirements.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: FASS departments may define additional GPA requirements for their respective programs.
